business_problem: Ellevio needed better remote visibility into the condition of substation assets so it could move from reactive and scheduled maintenance toward condition-based maintenance, reduce outages, and avoid unnecessary engineer visits to remote grid sites.
solution_summary: Ellevio and Gomero are integrating cloud-based sensor analytics into IBM Maximo to make substation maintenance more predictive and operationally connected. Secure wireless networks in substations collect data from measuring instruments and sensors across multiple asset classes and OEM variants, then Gomero's cloud platform collates and enriches that information before feeding it into Ellevio's Maximo environment. In Maximo, the data is tied to specific assets, combined with historical and manual information, and used to trigger automated work orders rather than generic alerts. The system gives maintenance teams a single-pane-of-glass view with substation-level drill-down, helps them plan preemptive interventions, and will support new micro-leakage monitoring for sulfur hexafluoride in circuit breakers and gas-insulated switchgear. The architecture turns remote sensor telemetry into actionable maintenance workflows instead of standalone warning messages.
